spec.title: Bottle A to B
spec.summary: Move a bottle between two points on a table.
spec.frame: World frame: metres, z up, origin on the floor.

calc.note: Governing point: a+approach; distance from the base mounting point to the task point; each marker and the same point raised by the approach height.
Nearest task point to the base; the robot must be able to fold in this far or stay clear.
Tool mass estimated as 0.3 + 0.15 x object mass (capped at 3 kg for objects up to 10 kg).

calc.formula: v = d / (T_move - t_a), t_a = T_move / 3, T_move = T_budget d_longest / sum_d
calc.note: Time budget (cycle time minus dwell) split over the moves by distance; moves are the legs between task points, the return to the first point and the approach up/down at each pick/place.
Acceleration as specified (raised if the move is infeasible in the time).
Friction grip: normal force per contact so friction carries weight plus acceleration. Acceleration a = 2 m/s^2 from tcp_accel.
Repeatability is taken as half the positional accuracy tolerance.
